headlines.title: 前7个月电子信息制造业增加值同比增长15.4%
headlines.summary: 记者从工业和信息化部了解到，今年前7个月，我国电子信息制造业生产保持快速增长，出口增速稳步上升，行业效益大幅增长。数据显示，1—7月份，规模以上电子信息制造业增加值同比增长15.4%，增速较去年同期高4.5个百分点。今年前7个月，规模以上电子信息制造业实现营业收入11.1万亿元，同比增长19.4%，利润总额同比增长1.05倍；累计实现出口交货值同比增长8%。投资方面，1—7月份，电子信息制造业固定资产投资同比增长7.8%，比去年同期增速高5.6个百分点。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Value added of electronic information manufacturing industry up 15.4% year-on-year in first 7 months
headlines.summary_en: Reporters learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that in the first seven months of this year, China's electronic information manufacturing industry saw rapid production growth, steadily rising export growth, and a significant increase in industry profits. Data shows that from January to July, the added value of electronic information manufacturing enterprises above designated size grew 15.4% year-on-year, 4.5 percentage points higher than the same period last year. In the first seven months of this year, these enterprises achieved operating revenue of 11.1 trillion yuan, up 19.4% year-on-year, with total profits surging 105% year-on-year; cumulative export delivery value grew 8% year-on-year. In terms of investment, fixed-asset investment in the electronic information manufacturing industry rose 7.8% year-on-year from January to July, 5.6 percentage points higher than the same period last year. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China-Egypt trade up 23.2% year-on-year in first 7 months
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce said today that China-Egypt economic and trade cooperation has entered the fast track, with bilateral trade growing 23.2% year-on-year in the first seven months of this year. China has remained Egypt's largest trading partner for 14 consecutive years. Bilateral trade reached $20.79 billion in 2025, a record high. From January to July this year, bilateral trade reached $13.75 billion, up 23.2% year-on-year. Driven by policies such as China's full zero-tariff treatment for African countries with diplomatic ties, Egyptian specialty products like fresh oranges and flax have seen rapid export growth to China, showing strong momentum. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: Report: Moonshot AI confidentially files with Hong Kong Stock Exchange, officially launching IPO
headlines.summary_en: It is reported that Moonshot AI (Kimi) submitted its A1 filing to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in confidential form this week, officially launching its Hong Kong IPO process. The A1 is one of the formal application documents companies submit when applying for a listing on the HKEX. Kimi responded to the news, saying: "We do not comment on market rumors, and there is currently no information to disclose." Separately, we understand that Kimi is also advancing a new funding round at a pre-investment valuation of $50 billion. This is likely to be the final round before Kimi's IPO. (LatePost)

headlines.title_en: China's first batch of imported Peruvian bananas arrives in Shanghai via 'Chancay-Shanghai' shipping route
headlines.summary_en: The first batch of imported Peruvian bananas in China passed inspection and supervision by Yangshan Customs under Shanghai Customs and cleared entry smoothly, marking the first time Peruvian fresh bananas have entered the Chinese market after gaining market access. The batch totals 19.6 tons and arrived in Shanghai via the Chancay-Shanghai shipping route. As a landmark project of China-Peru Belt and Road cooperation, since the route launched at the end of 2024, as of September 1 this year, Shanghai Customs has supervised 355,000 tons of import and export cargo on the route, valued at 9.87 billion yuan, with cargo categories expanding from 34 at launch to 75. (CCTV)

headlines.summary_en: On September 2, Li Auto officially launched the new-generation Li MEGA, with a nationwide unified retail price of 509,800 yuan. Orders open immediately, with deliveries starting within the week. The new model comes standard with dual zero-gravity seats in the first row, and the second-row rotating zero-gravity seats feature floating cushions and air-diamond-pattern Nappa leather for the first time, alongside two self-leveling electric tables. The chassis is standard-equipped with an active anti-roll magic carpet, steer-by-wire, and rear-wheel steering, matching the Li i6's turning radius. Intelligent features include the 8797 cabin chip and the dual-Mach embodied intelligence suite as standard. Powertrain specs include a standard 108 kWh ternary lithium 5C ultra-fast charging battery with front and rear dual-motor all-wheel drive, offering 710 km of range and a 10-minute charge for 500 km.

headlines.title: 摩根大通：贝森特将日本央行逼入加息的进退两难困境
headlines.summary: 在美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特发起公开施压行动之后，日本央行行长植田和男在临近本月政策决议之际，面临着异常严峻的金融市场动荡风险。 摩根大通证券首席日本经济学家藤田绫子（Ayako Fujita）表示：“在美国如此明确表态之后，如果日本央行不采取行动，将会是个问题。但如果市场认为日本央行没有美国的顺风就无法加息，那就会对加息的有效性构成重大风险。”“当前长期利率的上升速度，其实并非日本央行的过错。真正能同时遏制日元走弱和长期利率上升的，是政府发出可信的财政信号。”

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan: Bessent puts Bank of Japan in dilemma over rate hikes
headlines.summary_en: With U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent launching a public pressure campaign, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda faces an unusually severe risk of financial market turmoil ahead of this month's policy decision. Ayako Fujita, Chief Japan Economist at JPMorgan Securities, said: "After such clear statements from the U.S., it would be a problem if the BOJ doesn't act. But if the market believes the BOJ can't hike without a tailwind from the U.S., that poses a major risk to the effectiveness of a hike." "The current pace of rising long-term rates is not really the BOJ's fault. What can truly curb both yen weakness and rising long-term rates is a credible fiscal signal from the government."
